description: This file contains configuration and utility functions for authentication and API interaction in a React frontend project. It manages API base URL, tenant secret salt, and localStorage-based authentication session handling.

methods.name: normalizeBase64Url
methods.description: Normalizes a base64 URL string by replacing characters and removing padding.

methods.name: getStoredAuth
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the stored authentication object from localStorage.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently authenticated based on stored auth info.

methods.name: saveAuthSession
methods.description: Saves the login session, including token, into localStorage.

methods.name: clearAuthSession
methods.description: Removes the authentication session from localStorage.
